boardStatus: There is a separate Neuromuscular Medicine subspecialty certification examination, jointly recognized/cosponsored by ABPN and ABPMR. ABPN develops/administers/scores/analyzes the examination; ABPMR credentials its eligible diplomates. It is voluntary and does not itself confer practice privileges. MGH/BWH states graduates may sit the distinct ABEM Electrodiagnostic Medicine Boards; ABEM is not the NMM examination. Clinical Neurophysiology certification is also distinct and is not conflated with NMM.
boardEligibilityNotice: ABPN pathway requires prior qualifying neurology/child neurology certification and one year of ACGME-accredited subspecialty fellowship (with specified completion timing); ABPMR has separate PM&R diplomate, unrestricted license, 12-month ACGME training and programme-director recommendation requirements. Confirm current pathways with the boards. Independent course completion does not confer eligibility, certification or privileges.
